facts.text: Granville sits just east of the Juniata River, a waterway that has shaped the town’s early industry.
The township office opens for a brief lunch‑hour window starting June 2, 2025, a quirky local tradition.
A temporary burn ban that had been in place for months was lifted on April 27, 2026, allowing residents to resume normal fire‑related activities.
On May 25, 2026, Granville’s township office will close for the holiday, a reminder of the town’s community‑focused schedule.
The office’s daily closing time is 3:45 p.m., a fixed end to the workday for local officials.
Job seekers can apply for the Patrolman/Code Officer role until May 15, 2026, reflecting the township’s ongoing recruitment efforts.
